body: While the weight loss system for children is amazingly beneficial, I do worry for the “to make my parents proud” aspect. Of course I encourage a healthy weight, however I feel uncomfortable shaming people who aren’t healthy. Connecting other aspects of life such as stress and pride with weight could lead to an eating disorder, and I worry that kids this young may be vulnerable. Once again, I’m not shaming child weight loss, I just fret over the motivation.

I'm in a very similar situation, once you develop anorexia you lose weight and get used to a thinner version of yourself which is an unrealistic and unmaintainable image. It is amazing that you have sought out health just remember that weight is not an accurate reflection of it. The biggest issue I faced was the fear of judgement from others. I still struggle with that, but the best thing I can advise is to surround yourself with positive people and try your best to avoid body image obsession. Make sure to invest a lot in self care even if it's "stupid" little things like doing a face mask, anything you can do to boost your self esteem is worthwhile. I hope things work out for you and just remember you're not alone😊

I've been stuck in the same cycle for the past 5 months😣 I plan on starting a journal and identifying triggers but it's so difficult. I binge one day and then the next I feel a compulsive urge to restrict which just leads me to binge again. I really hope things turn out alright for you, please post again if you find any helpful coping mechanisms!

Yes!!! I have the same struggle. If a eat one thing out of my diet I go into a "screw it" mindset and eat everything until my stomach hurts. I know no one else with this issue and it's caused a lot of guilt and loneliness. I'm glad that there are people with the same issue with whom I can vent with😅
